text:
maria: Heads-up — VoltChip wants signoff on joint perf/W numbers next week. They want a co-announcement + marketplace tile. Can we agree on acceptance criteria and a launch script by Monday? :calendar:

alex: My suggested acceptance criteria:
- sustained throughput >= 9.5k tokens/s (per rack) at no more than 850W total
- perf/W >= 11 tokens/s/W for the 10B model profile
- p99 latency < 300ms for 512-context
Those are conservative, but give room for kernel tuning. Ok?

kevin: These look fine. We'll need the kernel micropatch (L2 prefetch tweak) merged; that buys ~8% perf/watt in our internal runs.
I'll land a PR today and run a quick staging sweep tomorrow.

kevin: ```
# local smoke command
run_bench --model redwood-10b --seq 512 --dur 300 \
  --collect perf,watt --hw=voltchip-rackA --out=artifacts/voltchip-smoke.log
```

julia: I'll start drafting the marketplace tile + social snippet. Need final numbers and an approved 16:9 image from VoltChip. If we have numbers by Mon EOD I can get copy + assets approved by Tue morning.

maria: Legal wants to review the co-announcement language — opened a ticket with them. ops-bot, any ETA on legal?

ops-bot: Legal review requested. Ticket LEGAL-412 created. Estimated turnaround: 48h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: Plan: kevin posts staging logs by Mon 5pm PT; if green we do a Tues 10am PT smoke in our prod-like lab with VoltChip engineers on the call. Julia will hold marketplace + press draft for signoff.

kevin: Copy. Running the staging sweep tomorrow AM. Will paste perf and watt CSVs here when done. :mechanical_arm:

julia: Also preparing a short "how we tested" blurb mentioning kernel micropatch and KV cache warmup parameters — will include config snippet for transparency.

maria: Great. Locking in Tues 10am PT for the cross-org call. If anything slips, ping here and we'll triage. :white_check_mark:
